List all profile resources.

## Synopsis

```text
.profiles
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints the names of all Profile resources, one per line. Profiles bundle ACLs that Console and User resources take over with Profile = &lt;name&gt;. The order is the internal configuration order and the list is not filtered by ACLs. It takes no arguments and only reads.

## Examples

List all profiles:

```text
.profiles
```
